body.name: CompletionComplexityDichotomyHandle
body.construction: For an exactly encoded rational input \(\widetilde W\), its recovered group system \(\mathcal G\), the known labels \(\ell\), an integer \(t\) with \(0\le t\le pq\), and either no prescribed pair or one prescribed pair \((g,r,c)\), define the promise decision problem \(\mathrm{COMP\text{-}EDGE}\) to ask whether there is a legal \(\omega\in\Omega(\widetilde W,\mathcal G,\ell)\), satisfying \(\omega_g=(r,c)\) when prescribed, such that \(E(\omega)\le t\). The promise is that \((\widetilde W,\mathcal G,\ell)\) is an exactly encoded instance of the canonical Yang model. The associated optimization and search task is \(\operatorname{CompOpt}(\widetilde W,\mathcal G,\ell;g,r,c)\).
